# White Cloud — Website Design for NZ Small Businesses
# https://wcloud.nz

## About
White Cloud is a web design service based in Christchurch, New Zealand. Founded by Jay, it helps New Zealand small businesses get online with affordable, professional, AI-optimised websites. No technical knowledge required from the client.

## What We Do
- Design and build websites for small businesses across New Zealand
- Specialise in AI-optimised websites that are readable and recommendable by AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google
- Provide monthly website care plans for ongoing maintenance

## Services & Pricing (NZD, one-off payments, all prices EXCLUDE GST)

**Cloud One — NZ$299 + GST** (NZ$343.85 incl. GST)
For sole traders and new businesses needing a simple online presence.
- Up to 3 pages (Home, About, Contact)
- Mobile-friendly design
- Contact form + Google Maps embed
- Basic SEO setup
- Delivered in 5–7 business days

**Cloud Plus — NZ$699 + GST** (NZ$803.85 incl. GST) *(Most Popular)*
A full website to showcase services and build customer trust.
- Up to 6 pages
- Full SEO setup + Google Business integration
- Services page, testimonials section, contact form + click-to-call
- Delivered in 7–10 business days

**Cloud Pro — NZ$1,099 + GST** (NZ$1,263.85 incl. GST)
Premium presence for businesses that want to stand out.
- Up to 10 pages
- Blog or news section, gallery or portfolio
- Advanced contact and booking forms
- Full SEO + sitemap
- Priority delivery in 5–7 business days

## Peelie (White Cloud's own app)
Peelie is a digital loyalty stamp card app for cafés, restaurants and local shops (bakeries, bookshops, toy shops, gift shops and more), made by White Cloud. It replaces paper stamp and loyalty cards. Launching in Christchurch (Ōtautahi), New Zealand, and available worldwide on the App Store.
- Status: coming soon to the App Store. Works on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo. Not on Android yet.
- For customers: at the counter, open Peelie, tap "Get my sticker" and show your QR code (or the code under it, like PL-7K2QX9). Staff scan it with the shop's own phone or iPad and the sticker lands on the card; location isn't needed. Snap a photo of your food and it becomes the sticker, or pick a ready-made one. Fill the card to get the shop's reward. Every sticker is kept in a food diary you can download.
- Customers never pay. Sign in with Apple, or with email (a sign-in link and a 6-digit code); no passwords.
- For shops: card designer, staff check in once a shift with their own PIN, ads and offers (notifications only to customers who opted in, at most two a week), plain-English analytics, and a printable window poster with QR code. No scanners or till changes. New shops are approved by the Peelie team before they can post.
- Plans for shops: Free plan with every feature for 1 staff member and up to 50 customers. Peelie Pro adds unlimited customers and staff: NZ$139.99 a year, with NZ$69.99 for the first year for new subscribers (about NZ$5.83 a month). Bought in the app through Apple ("Get Peelie Pro"); cancel any time in iPhone Settings > your name > Subscriptions. Apple sets matching prices in other countries.
- Safety: every shop post has a menu to report it or hide that shop's posts; the Peelie team reviews reports within 24 hours.
- Anti-cheat: only signed-in staff on the shop's device can give stickers, one sticker per customer per shop every 3 hours, a shift log, and alerts for unusual activity.
- Privacy: shops see a customer code and their own visits, not the customer's name, unless the customer switches on sharing for that shop. Location is only used on the phone and never stored. No ads, tracking or analytics companies. Data is stored with Supabase in Sydney, Australia. Accounts can be deleted in the app (NZ Privacy Act 2020).
- Contact: teampeelie@wcloud.nz
- Peelie website: https://wcloud.nz/peelieapp
- Help and FAQ: https://wcloud.nz/peelieapp/support
- Privacy policy: https://wcloud.nz/peelieapp/privacy
